liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Me And Bobby McGee** (2 reviews): Only Weir played acoustic guitar on a few tunes, including this song; Described as possibly the most soulless version of this song ever recorded [22][24]
- **The Boxer** (1 review): Joan Baez performed this tune and others before the band joined her [23]
- **Banks Of The Ohio** (1 review): Jerry used an acoustic guitar for the first verse before switching to electric [27]
- **Children Of The 80's** (1 review): Reviewer dismisses this song with a sarcastic comment, suggesting it is poor [28]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): This was the first Dark Star in almost three years and the first two-verse version since the early 70s [29]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Reviewer cites this as a version they always wanted to hear live but never had [29]
- **The Other One** (1 other source): John Cippolina is credited as a guest on this jam sequence [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-12-31.143570.sbd.healy.walker.scotton.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 38 songs; 248 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1981-12-31.143571.sbd.healy.walker.scotton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 38 songs; 248 min [2]
- **gd1981-12-31.sbd.walker.scotton.miller.96090.flac24**: soundboard; 35 songs; 247 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1981-12-31.mtx.tobin.126611.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 35 songs; 246 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd81-12-31.acoustic.warren.14040.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 5 songs; 25 min; rated 3.54/5 by 13 [21]. Said about its sound: Recording has marginal quality, resembling a mediocre audience tape with hiss and distortion; Reviewer notes the recording sounds like a mediocre audience tape with lack of presence [24][28]

## Around the show

- Reviewer admits to stealing a backstage pass to attend this specific concert [22]
- Reviewer was backstage with Joan Baez, who had dated Mickey Hart for a year and a half [26]
- Bill Graham provided food for the attendees after the show concluded [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-12-31.143570.sbd.healy.walker.scotton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Dan Healy and Joani Walker; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Paul Scotton; source: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes > Sony D5M (Dolby B)(TDK MA-R C90) [1]. Also: Joan Baez, Matt Kelly, and John Cippolina are listed as guests on specific tracks [1]
- **gd1981-12-31.143571.sbd.healy.walker.scotton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Dan Healy and Joani Walker; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Paul Scotton; source: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes > Sony D5M (Dolby B)(TDK MA-R C90) [2]. Also: Matt Kelly is credited as a guest on CC Rider, Big Boss Man, and Minglewood Blues [2]
- **gd1981-12-31.sbd.walker.scotton.miller.96090.flac24**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell UDXLII-S90) [3]. Also: This transfer is described as an upgrade to all previous circulating copies of the show [3]
- **gd1981-12-31.mtx.tobin.126611.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 3 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=96107) flac24; Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550/Maxell UDXLII-S90) Transfer Info: Cassette Master… [5]. Also: Joan Baez, Matt Kelly, and John Cippolina are identified as guests on various songs [5]
- **gd81-12-31.acoustic.warren.14040.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [21]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Auditorium Arena - December 31, 1981](https://www.dead.net/show/december-31-1981) [35]
